en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, form Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Muhammad Bin Humran,

(The narrator) says, ‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about a man who fabricated upon a group of people. So heasws said: ‘If they come with it altogether, he would be whipped one Penalty (Hadd), and if they come with it seperately, he would be whipped for each man, one Penalty (Hadd)’.
